description:
Upload up to 4 Touchstone files and get component values (L, C, R, Q, self-resonance) for a single component, plus insertion loss, return loss, group delay, TDR and passband ripple — all in one automated report.
Inputs: Units, ranges and defaults are in each parameter's schema; one left out takes its default. Takes 1 to 4 .s1p/.s2p/.s3p/.s4p file(s) via inputFiles (inline) or inputPaths (local paths); the server uploads them. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY. Cross-parameter checks: sweep_stop_after_start. Time budget 120 s; waitSeconds (default 90, max 600) bounds the wait.
Example: {"refImpedance":50,"freqStart":0,"freqStop":0,"inputPaths":["/path/to/file.s1p"]}
Returns: The port count, frequency range and detected two-port topology, each analysis stage it ran (network representations, passivity, and the extracted R, L or C with Q and self-resonance) with its values described as series, and any advisories. Also warnings, provenance and the result page link; series are described, not listed (full: true returns everything). If waitSeconds runs out first: the jobId and progress, and the job keeps running.
Runs as a job on rftools.io and counts against the monthly run allowance (free lane without a key).

freqStart.description: Analysis Freq Start (Hz). 0 = use file range. omit for the default of 0

freqStop.description: Analysis Freq Stop (Hz). 0 = use file range. omit for the default of 0

full.description: Return the whole result payload instead of the summary. Large.

inputFiles.description: 1–4 file(s), .s1p, .s2p, .s3p, .s4p. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY. Inline content; at most 5 MB in one call. The server uploads them and passes the keys.

name.description: File name including its extension, e.g. "channel.s4p"

inputPaths.description: 1–4 file(s), .s1p, .s2p, .s3p, .s4p. Uploading a file needs an API key; set RFTOOLS_API_KEY. Paths on this machine, read by the server and uploaded.

refImpedance.description: Reference Impedance (Ω). min 1. omit for the default of 50

waitSeconds.description: How long to wait for the result before returning the job id (0 = submit and return at once, max 600).

name: simulate_sparam_pipeline
title: S-Parameter Analysis Pipeline
